1use crate::third_party::hayro_postscript::array::{self, Array};
2use crate::third_party::hayro_postscript::error::{Error, Result};
3use crate::third_party::hayro_postscript::name::{self, Name};
4use crate::third_party::hayro_postscript::number::{self, Number};
5use crate::third_party::hayro_postscript::reader::Reader;
6use crate::third_party::hayro_postscript::string::{self, String};

8/// A PostScript object.
9#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
10pub enum Object<'a> {
11    /// A number object.
12    Number(Number),
13    /// A name object.
14    Name(Name<'a>),
15    /// A string object.
16    String(String<'a>),
17    /// An array object.
18    Array(Array<'a>),
19}
20
21pub(crate) fn read<'a>(r: &mut Reader<'a>) -> Result<Object<'a>> {
22    // PdfCraft patch: `<<` and `>>` are skipped by looping instead of
23    // recursing once per delimiter, so a long run cannot overflow the stack.
24    loop {
25        skip_whitespace_and_comments(r);
26
27        let b = r.peek_byte().ok_or(Error::SyntaxError)?;
28
29        return match b {
30            b'(' => string::parse_literal(r).map(|s| Object::String(String::from_literal(s))).ok_or(Error::SyntaxError),
31            b'<' => {
32                if r.peek_bytes(2) == Some(b"<~") {
33                    string::parse_ascii85(r).map(|s| Object::String(String::from_ascii85(s))).ok_or(Error::SyntaxError)
34                } else if r.peek_bytes(2) == Some(b"<<") {
35                    // TODO: Proper dict support. For now, skip `<<` and return
36                    // the next object so callers see the inner tokens.
37                    r.forward();
38                    r.forward();
39                    continue;
40                } else {
41                    string::parse_hex(r).map(|s| Object::String(String::from_hex(s))).ok_or(Error::SyntaxError)
42                }
43            }
44            b'/' => name::parse_literal(r).map(|s| Object::Name(Name::new(s, true))).ok_or(Error::SyntaxError),
45            b'[' => array::parse(r).map(|d| Object::Array(Array::new(d))),
46            b'>' => {
47                if r.peek_bytes(2) == Some(b">>") {
48                    // TODO: Proper dict support. Skip `>>` closing delimiter.
49                    r.forward();
50                    r.forward();
51                    continue;
52                } else {
53                    Err(Error::SyntaxError)
54                }
55            }
56            b'{' => {
57                r.forward();
58                Err(Error::UnsupportedType)
59            }
60            b'.' | b'+' | b'-' | b'0'..=b'9' => number::read(r).map(Object::Number),
61            _ => name::parse_executable(r).map(|s| Object::Name(Name::new(s, false))).ok_or(Error::SyntaxError),
62        };
63    }
64}
65
66pub(crate) fn at_end(r: &mut Reader<'_>) -> bool {
67    skip_whitespace_and_comments(r);
68    r.peek_byte().is_none()
69}
70
71pub(crate) fn skip_whitespace_and_comments(r: &mut Reader<'_>) {
72    loop {
73        match r.peek_byte() {
74            Some(b) if crate::third_party::hayro_postscript::reader::is_whitespace(b) => {
75                r.forward();
76            }
77            Some(b'%') => {
78                r.forward();
79                r.forward_while(|b| !crate::third_party::hayro_postscript::reader::is_eol(b));
80            }
81            _ => return,
82        }
83    }
84}

86#[cfg(any())]
87mod tests {
88    use super::*;
89
90    fn read_one(input: &[u8]) -> Result<Object<'_>> {
91        let mut r = Reader::new(input);
92        read(&mut r)
93    }
94
95    fn read_ok(input: &[u8]) -> Object<'_> {
96        read_one(input).unwrap()
97    }
98
99    fn read_err(input: &[u8]) -> Error {
100        read_one(input).unwrap_err()
101    }
102
103    #[cfg(any())]
104    fn integer() {
105        assert_eq!(read_ok(b"42 "), Object::Number(Number::Integer(42)));
106    }
107
108    #[cfg(any())]
109    fn negative_integer() {
110        assert_eq!(read_ok(b"-7 "), Object::Number(Number::Integer(-7)));
111    }
112
113    #[cfg(any())]
114    fn literal_name() {
115        assert_eq!(read_ok(b"/CMapName "), Object::Name(Name::new(b"CMapName", true)));
116    }
117
118    #[cfg(any())]
119    fn executable_name() {
120        let obj = read_ok(b"beginbfchar ");
121        assert_eq!(obj, Object::Name(Name::new(b"beginbfchar", false)));
122    }
123
124    #[cfg(any())]
125    fn literal_string() {
126        assert_eq!(read_ok(b"(Hello)"), Object::String(String::from_literal(b"Hello")));
127    }
128
129    #[cfg(any())]
130    fn hex_string() {
131        assert_eq!(read_ok(b"<48656C6C6F>"), Object::String(String::from_hex(b"48656C6C6F")));
132    }
133
134    #[cfg(any())]
135    fn ascii85_string() {
136        assert_eq!(read_ok(b"<~87cURDZ~>"), Object::String(String::from_ascii85(b"87cURDZ")));
137    }
138
139    #[cfg(any())]
140    fn array_simple() {
141        let obj = read_ok(b"[1 2 3]");
142        assert_eq!(obj, Object::Array(Array::new(b"1 2 3")));
143    }
144
145    #[cfg(any())]
146    fn stray_close_bracket() {
147        assert_eq!(read_err(b"]"), Error::SyntaxError);
148    }
149
150    #[cfg(any())]
151    fn stray_gt() {
152        assert_eq!(read_err(b">x"), Error::SyntaxError);
153    }
154
155    #[cfg(any())]
156    fn skips_whitespace() {
157        assert_eq!(read_ok(b"  \t\n 42 "), Object::Number(Number::Integer(42)));
158    }
159
160    #[cfg(any())]
161    fn skips_comments() {
162        assert_eq!(read_ok(b"% this is a comment\n42 "), Object::Number(Number::Integer(42)));
163    }
164
165    #[cfg(any())]
166    fn eof() {
167        assert!(read_one(b"").is_err());
168        assert!(read_one(b"   ").is_err());
169        assert!(read_one(b"% comment only\n").is_err());
170    }
171
172    // PdfCraft patch: `<<` and `>>` runs are skipped without recursion.
173    #[cfg(any())]
174    fn long_open_dict_run_does_not_overflow() {
175        let input = alloc::vec![b'<'; 1_000_000];
176        assert_eq!(read_err(&input), Error::SyntaxError);
177    }
178
179    #[cfg(any())]
180    fn long_close_dict_run_does_not_overflow() {
181        let input = b">>".repeat(500_000);
182        assert_eq!(read_err(&input), Error::SyntaxError);
183    }
184
185    #[cfg(any())]
186    fn dict_delimiters_are_skipped() {
187        let mut r = Reader::new(b"<< /A 1 >>");
188        assert_eq!(read(&mut r), Ok(Object::Name(Name::new(b"A", true))));
189        assert_eq!(read(&mut r), Ok(Object::Number(Number::Integer(1))));
190        assert_eq!(read(&mut r), Err(Error::SyntaxError));
191    }
192
193    #[cfg(any())]
194    fn nested_dict_delimiters_are_skipped() {
195        let mut r = Reader::new(b"<<<< /X >>>> 7 <<\n% c\n<< >> 8");
196        assert_eq!(read(&mut r), Ok(Object::Name(Name::new(b"X", true))));
197        assert_eq!(read(&mut r), Ok(Object::Number(Number::Integer(7))));
198        assert_eq!(read(&mut r), Ok(Object::Number(Number::Integer(8))));
199        assert!(at_end(&mut r));
200    }
201}
